dedupe_keys.name: before during and after flood uav generated digital elevation models orthomosaics and gis datasets of the distal part of zackenberg river northeast greenland august 2017

description: Adam Mickiewicz University publishes processed terrain and mapping products for the August 2017 glacier-lake outburst flood at the Zackenberg River in northeast Greenland. UAV photographs from 5, 6 and 8 August were processed with structure-from-motion methods to create digital elevation models, orthomosaics and hillshade models. Geomorphological vectors and uncertainty-assessment material are also listed in the public ZIP archives. Zenodo applies CC-BY-4.0, allowing free reuse with attribution. The landing metadata does not establish a single numerical grid spacing. Survey alignment and photogrammetric uncertainty limit how small an elevation change can be interpreted. The deposit explicitly supports analysis of bank erosion, channel stability and hazards to station buildings and the bridge. It can therefore help calibrate flood and erosion simulations at this site. These derived products complement the separate raw-image deposit; they do not remove the need to inspect uncertainty and coordinate definitions before modelling.
name: Before-, during-, and after-flood UAV-generated digital elevation models, orthomosaics, and GIS datasets of the distal part of Zackenberg river, northeast Greenland (August 2017)
